li-25UF.title: Landscape: built-up ridge north, big mountains
li-25UF.summary: In the north, you see a low ridge to the north with more buildings on its side, and much bigger mountains to the south and southeast.

li-5YU7.title: Landscape: mountains all around
li-5YU7.summary: East of the main mountain ridge, mountains surround you in every direction.

li-9VvC.title: Street sign: brown with arrow design
li-9VvC.summary: Brown street signs shaped like an arrow are unique to one northern town, though regular brown signs appear there too.

li-BTob.title: Sign: black bus stop sign
li-BTob.summary: In the far south, black bus stop signs sometimes appear. Normal ones are there too.

li-Ctc1.title: Pedestrian sign: seven stripes, tall rectangle
li-Ctc1.summary: Seven zebra stripes inside an oddly tall rectangle. Switzerland uses identical signs.

li-DhYM.title: Road separator: yellow-black, Lego-like knob
li-DhYM.summary: Yellow-and-black striped road separators with a rounded top and a knob on top: 3 stripes of each colour, yellow at the bottom. Some Swiss separators look identical.

li-Hu33.title: Landscape: two rocky peaks to the north
li-Hu33.summary: In the flat southwest with a diagonal road grid, you can often see two rocky peaks to the north or northwest, across the border in Switzerland.

li-NSbp.title: Landscape: steep rocky cliff with trees
li-NSbp.summary: A steep rocky cliff with trees at its base and on top, seen near the village of Mäls.

li-PSiM.title: Street sign: flat black
li-PSiM.summary: Flat black signs are found in the east.

li-Q2Ay.title: Street sign: brown, plain generic font
li-Q2Ay.summary: Brown signs with a plain, generic font belong to the small village of Planken.

li-SrOE.title: Landscape: flat valley, mountains to the east
li-SrOE.summary: Most coverage is in a flat river valley with tall mountains almost everywhere, always towering to the east. Pastures and farmland fill the valley floor.

li-UNBX.title: Houses: Alpine mix of old and modern
li-UNBX.summary: A blend of traditional Alpine houses and more modern buildings, mostly in the larger towns.

li-UTf6.title: Street sign: brown with old German-style font
li-UTf6.summary: Brown street signs with a white border and a font like traditional German lettering, in the capital and northern towns.

li-X4GL.title: Google car: low camera, big car blur
li-X4GL.summary: The camera sits lower than usual, so the car blur is much bigger and roads look wider. The big blur is the easiest sign. Switzerland and Japan also always have it.

li-c1EG.title: Landscape: the only lakes
li-c1EG.summary: The only lakes in the country are just south of Steg, in the middle of the mountains.

li-ci1R.title: Sign: green-white bus stop, LIEMOBIL
li-ci1R.summary: Green-and-white bus stop sign with a black metal border and LIEMOBIL written at the top. The frame is not always black.

li-fK9u.title: Landscape: small forested ridge to the south
li-fK9u.summary: In the northwest corner, a small forested ridgeline lies to the south, a big contrast to the tall mountains elsewhere.

li-gG0N.title: Sign: red bus stop sign
li-gG0N.summary: In the capital, red bus stop signs sometimes appear. Normal ones are there too.

li-iJBv.title: Street sign: blue with thin white border
li-iJBv.summary: Blue street signs with a thin white border mean the south or the north near Bendern.

li-mKMX.title: Street sign: black, white border, raised letters
li-mKMX.summary: Black signs with a white border and embossed letters are from one central town.

li-ndYF.title: Sign: round grey metal border
li-ndYF.summary: Road signs often have a round grey metal border. Swiss and German signs can have similar borders.

li-p90S.title: Bollard: black-white cylinder, blue side tab
li-p90S.summary: A black-and-white cylinder with a rounded top, white or grey reflector, and often a blue attachment on the side. On guardrails it uses a wedge shape instead. Swiss bollards can look almost identical.

li-qb5C.title: Direction sign: white or blue, pointed arrow
li-qb5C.summary: Direction signs are white on small roads and blue on bigger ones, with a pointed arrowhead in a contrasting colour. Same as Switzerland.

li-rcYy.title: Plate: black with yellow-red emblem
li-rcYy.summary: Black plates with white letters and a yellow-and-red emblem near the left. When blurred they look grey but the emblem colours still show.

li-t5Ye.title: Street sign: blue with no outline
li-t5Ye.summary: Blue street signs without an outline are from one northern town.

li-uDcT.title: Landscape: rolling hills in the northeast
li-uDcT.summary: A band of rolling hills runs northeast toward the Austrian border. The rest of the country is either very flat or in the mountains.

li-wjF4.title: Landscape: dense mountain slope above valley
li-wjF4.summary: A fairly built-up area on a mountain slope, with the flat river valley often visible below to the west.
